limitations.note: The rewrite made `number` the counter state instead of registering the previous `num`, so a set value appeared one rising edge too early.
The rewrite also changed the asynchronous reset value of `zero` from low to high, although the correct fix preserves the original flag logic.
The test expected a set value to appear on the same edge that captured it, so its passing result confirmed the rewrite’s timing assumption rather than checking the required one-edge delay.

limitations.quote: a clocked block using a nonblocking assignment samples the pre-edge value of the register it reads
limitations.note: The agent read the relevant timing guidance but did not use the existing `zero` register’s pre-edge sample to identify which value `number` needed to publish.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: Bundling the edit and simulation with a rejected cleanup command prevented either from running, forcing the agent to resubmit both separately.
